purpose: Repeatable model-behavior scenarios, separate from the CI definition-drift checks. Give an evaluator only the consumerContract and cases, together with the agent definition; compare its decisions with expected afterward.

consumerContract.scope: The synthetic repository example/product only; use the supplied evidence without forge access.
consumerContract.selectionOrder: Security issues, then Bugs, then all remaining issues; oldest creation time first within each tier.
consumerContract.question: For each case, report the exact selected candidate, evidenced-empty result, or scoped unknown; whether full-survey freshness may advance; and whether successful Operate evidence is retained.
consumerContract.commonEvidence: Repository/default-head, PR, issue/type, claim-ref, and Project censuses are complete and freshly verified. Operate checks succeeded. Unless overridden, ranking is complete and every candidate's applicable maintainer-control, open-PR, claim, dependency, automation, specification, and measurement-date joins are complete and clear. A is older than B; both are Bugs. No other issues exist.

cases.evidence: The issue universe contains A and B, but the ranking and per-candidate actionability joins were deliberately not computed. All five censuses remain complete.
The universe contains A and B. A's maintainer-control read failed. B's applicable joins all completed and are clear.

The universe contains A and B. A's current claim tip is ten minutes old and belongs to another instance; its exact tip and time are retained as evidence. Every other applicable join for both candidates completed and is clear.

The complete universe contains A and B. A has a verified ten-minute-old foreign claim; B has a freshly verified open dependency. Exact evidence references are retained for both. Every other applicable join completed and is clear.

The complete universe contains only A. It has a blocked label without supporting maintainer control or dependency, plus a claim whose verified tip is three hours old. No open PR exists; all other applicable joins completed and are clear.
The complete universe contains only A. Its declared measurement date was yesterday. No blocker or open PR exists; all applicable joins completed and are clear.

complete-census-without-ranking.result: QUERY-UNKNOWN: ranking and actionability evidence missing

older-control-query-failed.result: QUERY-UNKNOWN: A control read; B provisional only

live-claim-before-ready-candidate.result: B selected with A's current claim as preceding skip evidence

evidenced-empty.result: ADVANCE-EMPTY with complete universe and both current skip references
